text: Si Aayeeje Amen Alqur'aana ɓannguɗe tinndinɗe ngootaaku Alla ɗen no janngeede, ɓen yedduɓe ummital ɓe tamƴinaaki mbarjaari, ɓe hulaa kadi lepte wi'a : "An Muhammadu, addu Alqur'aanaare goo hara wanaa ndee yowondirnde ɗoo e yennu- de rewugol sanamu" maa ɗum "waɗtitiraa nde momtugol yoga mayre, maa momtugol nde haa heddoo ko yaadata e mbeleeɗe amen ɗen". Maakan ɓe an Nulaaɗo : "Sellataa ka mi waɗtita nde min, mi gaynataa ɗum, wanaa non feere addu- gol wonnde goo. Ko Alla tun waɗtitirta goɗɗum e mayre no O haajiri. Min on mi jokkaa si wanaa ko Alla wahayini kon e am. Min miɗo huli, si mi yeddirii Alla waɗugol faale mon, heɓugol lepte ñalaande mawnde, nden woni Ñalnde Darngal".
